name: Análisis de Frecuencia N-gram
description: Analiza word and character n-grama distribucións para detectar patrones characteristic of generado por IA text.
useCase: Detecting AI text through análisis estadístico of word sequence patrones
mechanism: Extrae character-level and word-level n-grama frequency distribucións and compares them against known distribucións for human and generado por IA text. AI text generators produce characteristic n-grama patrones — often over-representing common phrases and under-representing rare but natural human constructions.
source: Lavergne et al. (2008) - Detecting Fake Content with Relative Entropy Scoring, PAN-SEPLN
algorithm: N-gram Extraction + Frequency Distribution Analysis + KL-Divergence Scoring
parameters: N-gram sizes: 2-5, Level: character + word, Comparison: KL-divergence, chi-square, Corpus: reference distribucións
strengths:
• Language-model agnostic approach
• Can analyze very short texts
• Computacionalmente eficiente
• Captures subtle distribución differences
limitations:
• Requires reference distribucións for calibration
• Domain-specific text may skew results
• Modern AI models converge toward natural distribucións
• Cross-domain generalization can be weak

references.title: Lavergne, T. et al. (2008). Detecting Fake Content with Relative Entropy Scoring. PAN-SEPLN.
Solaiman, I. et al. (2019). Release Strategies and the Social Impacts of Language Models. OpenAI Technical Report.
Beresneva, D. (2016). Computer-Generated Text Detection Using Machine Learning: A Systematic Review. NLDB.
